notes.title: 1.2.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] In addition to conventional 16:9 ratio monitors, the Packit List now supports 16:10, 3:4, 21:9, and 32:9 ratio monitors. No more UI being cut off or images being stretched.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the camera to occasionally malfunction severely when clearing a Level.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Items are now placed gently instead of being dropped from a height.
[*]The textures of all items have been improved.
[*]All achievement thumbnails have become even cuter.
[/list]
[h1]Other Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The speed of camera rotation has been significantly reduced.
[*]The trash bin in the Epilogue level has been slightly reduced in size.
[*]Shaking the monster cage in the Fantasy level now triggers a more natural reaction.
[*]Due to the removal of the item drop mechanism, the "Master Sniper" achievement has been removed.
[*]Camera preset buttons, which were previously only displayed after clicking the camera button in the top left, are now visible from the start.
[*]In the Epilogue level, placing the mouse on the mouse pad now allows both to be lifted together.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.4 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug where the "Alchemist" achievement was not clearing correctly.[/b] Sorry for keeping you so long.
[*] Resolved an issue where achievement details were not properly sorted upon initial load.
[*] Adjusted the size, speed, and colors of various particles.
[*] Modified item interaction so items can be picked up even without perfect mouse alignment.
[*] Picnic stage: Slightly increased the size of the sandwich.
[*] Added small particles to cutscenes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Joseon level: Improved the texture resolution of the traditional mask item.
[*] Spy level: Updated the textures of certain items to make it easier to identify which items need to be hidden and which do not.
[*] Increased snapping distances for certain objects (e.g., the fake floor item in the Spy level).
[*] Help tips are now displayed on the loading screen.
[*] Improved particle effects for the clear button and the particle effects that appear around the bag when cleared.
[*] When launching the game for the first time, the language is automatically set based on the user’s preferences.
[*] In the title screen, the 'Play' button has been renamed to 'Continue,' and a new 'New Game' button has been added.
[*] Added VFX artist Jo Woo-sung to the credits.
[*] The bag now stays open longer after clearing a level.
[*] Added a cute hand-drawn image in the corner of the level selection screen, and after clearing all levels, the image appears fully colored.
[/list]

[h1]Minor Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Joseon level: Added missing textures to certain environmental objects.
[*] Added a pill pack illustration to the cutscene where two friends are hanging out at a karaoke room.
[*] Progress saves have been further detailed, so if the game is closed during a cutscene, it will resume from that cutscene.
[*] The second tutorial graphic now appears faster in the first level.
[*] Fixed a bug where the achievement descriptions were not properly aligned on the first display.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Modified so that after dropping an object, it cannot be picked up again for 0.1 seconds.
[*] Epilogue Level: Adjusted so that when placing headphones on the stuffed mouse, the headphones will also be picked up when picking up the mouse.
[*] Epilogue Level: Changed so that when object is placed in the trash bin, no collision sfx of the bin is played.
[*] Hospital Level: Adjusted the lighting to gradually return to its normal color after clearing the level, so that the bag no longer appears blue.
[*] Picnic Level: Both mugs' handles face the same direction now.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107290/de73b31507845a04d905206c740507ea026eada7.png[/img]

[h1]Major Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] The sides of the bag have been made more transparent, and the ghost of the object you're holding has been made more opaque to improve visibility.
[*] Added sound effects that play when you hover over or click on UI buttons.
[*] When holding an object, a dotted line that drops vertically now also shows the height of the ghost, making it easier to gauge distance more intuitively.
[*] The ghost of the object you're holding now accurately matches the point of impact where it will collide.
[*] Adjusted asymmetrical objects to have a more natural center point.
[*] Fixed a critical bug that could occur when pressing Alt+Tab while holding an object.
[*] Added sound effects that play when the bags close.
[*] Hospital Level: The special nature of the pink bucket list object, which is the only item that is picked up while lying down despite being a book, is now more noticeable. To achieve this, the level now starts with the object placed inside the bag.
[*] Fantasy Level: Adjusted the size and rotation of certain objects to allow for a variety of solutions without discomfort.
[*] Spy Level: It is now easier to place objects flush against the walls when trying to place them on the lower floor.
[*] Epilogue Level: When you press the clear button, a confirmation UI will now appear.
[/list]

[h1]Other Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] The small amount of inertia when placing objects has been removed.
[*] The criteria for displaying the dashed floor that helps gauge the height of objects have been adjusted so it now appears in more situations.
[*] Fixed a bug where background music would not play when returning to the title screen from in-game.
[*] The background music of the final cutscene now continues until the credits finish.
[*] Additional sound effects have been added to certain cutscenes.
[*] Changed the sound effects that play when some objects fall.
[*] Fixed an issue where some sound effects were not affected by the volume settings.
[*] Picnic Basket Level: Fixed an issue where the two sandwiches would snap together slightly misaligned.
[*] Fantasy Level: Fixed an issue where the sound effect that plays when placing a potion on the potion holder was unnatural.
[*] Spy Level: Fixed a minor misalignment between the mesh of the bag's bottom and the actual collider.
[*] Epilogue Level: Fixed an issue where the chair, unlike the desk, is obscured by the background when clearing the level.
[*] Epilogue Level: Adjusted the achievement that requires you to clean up trash so that it only counts if you close the trash can lid.
[/list]

notes.title: Better controls + Japanese support Update
notes.content:
[h1]Massive Quality-of-Life Improvements + Japanese Support is Here![/h1]

Hi everyone, we hope the wait wasn’t too long :)

As previously announced, this update focuses on two key areas: improving gameplay experience and adding in-game Japanese language support. Have you ever struggled to perfectly align comic books, only for them to end up in a mess? Or have you carefully organized items in a container, only to watch them spill out the moment you set it down? Worry no more! With this update, we hope you can enjoy a stress-free experience, fully immersing yourself in the art of organization and puzzle-solving with "Packit List."

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]When a player picks up a 'container' object (e.g., the plastic container from the 'Picnic' level), small objects inside it will now 'stick' to the container and act as if it's part of the container.[/b]
[*][b]Most objects now 'block' each other slightly. This is particularly useful when you want to place items close together, like comic books.[/b]
[*][b]You can now skip cutscenes by pressing the 'esc' button.[/b]
[*]Small wooden blocks from the 'Joseon' level (known as Hopae, which were used as identification in the Joseon dynasty) now snap along the axis of the wooden box, making it much easier to place them inside.
[*]Items now drop from a much lower height in most levels, preventing them from scattering on impact.
[*]Fixed a bug where the ghosts of objects were not displaying correctly. Now, you can more accurately predict where the object will land. (It's still not perfect yet though.)
[/list]

[h2]Japanese Support[/h2]
You can now select the Japanese language option in the in-game settings. If you notice any awkward translations or if you can help with the translation, please let us know in the comments. Thank you.

[h2]Other Bugfixes and Minor Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where containers with objects inside would behave strangely when thrown.
[*]Fixed several bugs where levels could be completed without placing all items in the bag.
[*]Fixed a bug where some items were sticking out the bag when put close to the walls of the bag.
[*]Now, all items fall the same distance regardless of their size.
[*]The can(trash) in the Epilogue level now snaps to the trash bin.
[*]Slightly eased the height requirement for clearing the Spy level.
[/list]

notes.title: Hello There! + Tiny Heads-Up for Next Update + Hotfix 240808
notes.content:
[h1]Hello There![/h1]
First and foremost, we would like to thank all players around the world for showing such love for 'Packit List'. We are grateful for the unexpected amount of encouragement and valuable feedback we have received. We are glad that you are part of this incredible journey with us, and we are committed to continually improving the game based on your insights and suggestions.

[h1]So, What's Next?[/h1]
We decided to start working on fundamental updates that will have a tremendous impact on the core gameplay experience: [b]CONTROLS[/b]. We are fully aware of how frustrating the controls could be at times. We aim to significantly improve the controlling aspect of the game so that players no longer struggle to move their pointers pixel by pixel to get it just right.

Secondly, we are aware that a great number of players from Japan are sending love. We were planning to launch the game with Japanese support initially, but unfortunately, we stumbled upon a few major problems and had to postpone it. We are working very hard on this subject and hopefully, we can have [b]Japanese support[/b] in the next update.

That's about it for the next update! Don't worry, it won't be the last one, and we have a long list of improvements for our players. (btw, we love achievements as much as you do.) Until then, we hope for the best for you.

[h1]Hotfix 240808[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where tutorial graphics for camera control appears strangely after restarting the firtst level.
- Fixed a bug where clicking effects don't show up in the right spot.
- Fixed UI sorting issue on the achievements page.
- Added a few missing textures in the background.
- Fixed several bugs regarding achievements' completion logic (e.g. 'Alchemist', 'Line Up' can be cleared normally, and so on).
- Fixed a few bugs that caused objects to go through other objects.
- Fixed a bug where in 'Joseon' level, coin bundle object could not be held in a box.
- Reduced sizes of a few objects slightly to prevent unneccesary collisions.
- Fixed a bug where desk boundary acted weird upon picking up objects for the first time.
